scope: Opt-in same-host shared SQLite pre-TLS ingress quotas across gateway processes: aggregate active sockets, per-peer active sockets, and global connection-rate tokens.
shared_ingress_scope: Processes on one host using the exact same trusted local SQLite path and matching configuration. Not a multi-host/distributed quota service.
known_limits: A request handler paused longer than the ingress lease TTL could resume after lease reclamation; this design is not a hard process-kill fence.
SQLite state is trusted local infrastructure; the quota store does not provide cryptographic database tamper resistance.
The feature is opt-in; omitting shared_ingress_quota_db_path retains process-local pre-TLS behavior.
All gateway replicas must use the same database path and matching active, per-IP, rate and TTL configuration.
Production CA/certificate rotation, reverse proxy, host firewall, cgroup/file-descriptor limits and distributed quota authority were not tested.
No upstream source mutation, pull request, upstream CI run or hosted service call occurred.
verification_boundary: All results are from the local reference artifact. The source pin identifies the observed upstream base commit and hashes of local artifact files; it does not establish that this research code is byte-equivalent to upstream.
